message.Title: Generally Available: Elastic clusters on Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server

Body.Content:
Now you can use elastic clusters to horizontally scale Azure Database for PostgreSQL through row-based and schema-based sharding. Elastic clusters make it easy to build multitenant apps by offloading shard management and operations—such as tenant isolation, split, or online rebalancing of shards—to the service.  

 

Row-based sharding is ideal for multitenant software as a service (SaaS) deployments, as it splits tenants into rows within a cluster-distributed table, enhancing density and improving margins per tenant. Alternatively, schema-based sharding suits microservices and lift-and-shift migrations of existing applications, offering more customization of schemas for each tenant.  

Learn more.
